## Three changes cut the paper bill by 11%
layout: cards-3
kicker: The offer
label1: One supplier
footer1: Saves 6% on price
label2: One invoice
footer2: Saves 3% in billing time
label3: One route plan
footer3: Saves 2% in freight
takeaway: About $96,000 saved each year

### body1
- All 14 sites, one contract
- **Tiered** pricing from case one

### body2
- One invoice per region
- Line items by site

### body3
- Deliveries batched by building
- Fixed weekday windows

Notes:
Each change starts in the first month of the contract. Volume pricing saves 6%, one invoice saves 3% in accounts payable time, and batched routes save 2% in freight.
Source: savings modeled on the 2025 purchasing summary at the proposed 2027 price list.

## Switching takes eight weeks, not a quarter
layout: process-4
kicker: The switch
step1: Survey
text1: We visit all 14 sites and log what each one orders.
step2: Price
text2: Purchasing signs off one price list.
step3: Pilot
text3: Three sites switch first, with a weekly call.
step4: Roll out
text4: The other 11 sites switch by week eight.
takeaway: No site runs out of paper during the switch

Notes:
The survey takes two weeks. Each pilot site gets a named driver. The old contracts wind down as each site switches.
